In the article, ["True Teamwork in Software Development"](https://medium.com/@martinbaun/true-teamwork-in-software-development-ca2bd3709adc), the authors talk about the following:

1.  Open Communication
2.  Feedback
3.  Celebrating Successes
4.  Learning from Failures
5.  Everyone should commit to the set plans and the goals of collaboration will be achieved.
